title: Gorgas Hospital Oncology Building, Ancón
geometryBasis: The mapped rectangle and street centerline fix the seven-level oncology block and its relation to Calle Gorgas. The exact 2012 street photograph establishes the concrete slab, lower verandas, sloping portal, repetitive fins and brick lattice.
sectionBasis: The map gives 22 m total height. The photograph establishes relative floors, visible setbacks, main corner pier and lower lattice galleries. Upper wing depth and rear-side details are estimated. The photographed concrete portal projects toward the sidewalk by approximately 2.8 m beyond the mapped rectangle.
limitations: The 2012 exterior covers the oncology block and its podium on the historic hospital grounds.
The street photo establishes the exposed concrete facade and fins. The tower depth, rear elevations and selected terrace details are estimates.
The original hillside elevation remains unchanged. The podium and street contact use approximate local grade.
